results.title: [2008.06141] Analytical bounds on the local Lipschitz constants of affine-ReLU functions
results.content: # Title:Analytical bounds on the local Lipschitz constants of affine-ReLU functions. View a PDF of the paper titled Analytical bounds on the local Lipschitz constants of affine-ReLU functions, by Trevor Avant and 1 other authors. > Abstract:In this paper, we determine analytical bounds on the local Lipschitz constants of of affine functions composed with rectified linear units (ReLUs). Using an analytical approach, we mathematically determine upper bounds on the local Lipschitz constant of an affine-ReLU function, show how these bounds can be combined to determine a bound on an entire network, and discuss how the bounds can be efficiently computed, even for larger layers and networks. | Cite as: | arXiv:2008.06141 [cs.LG] |. |  | (or  arXiv:2008.06141v1 [cs.LG] for this version) |.
